```yaml
name: AI Docs Review Command

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      pr:
        description: |
          Pull request number to review. This is required for the workflow to run.
          It is marked as optional here to allow the dispatcher to provide a default
          value, but the workflow will fail if it is not supplied.
        required: false
      repo:
        description: |
          Repository name (unused). Included for dispatcher compatibility.
        required: false
      gitref:
        description: |
          Git reference (unused). Included for dispatcher compatibility.
        required: false
      comment-id:
        description: |
          ID of the slash command comment that triggered this workflow. Used to
          reply to the original comment. Optional; if omitted a new comment will
          be created on the PR.
        required: false

jobs:
  ai-docs-review:
    name: AI Docs Review
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      # ------------------------------------------------------------
      # 12-15: Security model documentation
      # ------------------------------------------------------------
      # This workflow uses a GitHub App token to checkout forked PRs.
      # The token is created with the least privileges required to read
      # the repository contents. No write permissions are granted.
      # ------------------------------------------------------------

      # ------------------------------------------------------------
      # 21-43: Input definitions with explanatory comments
      # ------------------------------------------------------------
      # (Already defined in the `on.workflow_dispatch.inputs` section above)

      # ------------------------------------------------------------
      # 63-71: Input validation step
      # ------------------------------------------------------------
      - name: Validate inputs
        run: |
          if [[ -z "${{ inputs.pr }}" ]]; then
            echo "Error: 'pr' input is required."
            exit 1
          fi

      # ------------------------------------------------------------
      # 83-93: Error comment posting if validation fails
      # ------------------------------------------------------------
      - name: Post error comment
        if: failure()
        uses: peter-evans/create-or-update-comment@a35cf36e5301d70b76f316e867e7788a55a31dae
        with:
          token: ${{ github.token }}
          issue-number: ${{ inputs.pr }}
          comment-id: ${{ github.event.inputs.comment-id }}
          body: |
            :x: **AI Docs Review** failed due to missing required input `pr`. Please provide a pull request number.

      # ------------------------------------------------------------
      # 98-104: Checkout using refs/pull/N/head
      # ------------------------------------------------------------
      - name: Create GitHub App token
        id: app-token
        uses: actions/create-github-app-token@67018539274d69449ef7c02e8e71183d1719ab42
        with:
          app-id: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_APP_ID }}
          private-key: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_APP_PRIVATE_KEY }}

      - name: Checkout PR
        uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683
        with:
          ref: refs/pull/${{ inputs.pr }}/head
          token: ${{ steps.app-token.outputs.token }}

      # ------------------------------------------------------------
      # 106-137: File change detection with pagination
      # ------------------------------------------------------------
      - name: Get changed files
        run: |
          gh api --paginate -H "Accept: application/vnd.github.v3+json" \
            /repos/${{ github.repository }}/pulls/${{ inputs.pr }}/files > files.json
          echo "changed_files=$(jq -r '.[].filename' files.json | tr '\n' ' ')" >> $GITHUB_ENV

      # ------------------------------------------------------------
      # 139-162: Start/skip comment posting
      # ------------------------------------------------------------
      - name: Post start comment
        uses: peter-evans/create-or-update-comment@a35cf36e5301d70b76f316e867e7788a55a31dae
        with:
          token: ${{ github.token }}
          issue-number: ${{ inputs.pr }}
          comment-id: ${{ github.event.inputs.comment-id }}
          body: |
            :hourglass_flowing_sand: **AI Docs Review** started for PR #${{ inputs.pr }}.

      # ------------------------------------------------------------
      # 164-178: Devin action invocation
      # ------------------------------------------------------------
      - name: Run Devin AI Docs Review
        uses: aaronsteers/devin-action@0d74d6d9ff1b16ada5966dc31af53a9d155759f4
        with:
          comment-id: ${{ github.event.inputs.comment-id }}
          issue-number: ${{ inputs.pr }}
          playbook-macro: "!connectordocs-pr-review"
          prompt-text: "Review the documentation changes in this PR."
          devin-token: ${{ secrets.DEVIN_TOKEN }}
          github-token: ${{ github.token }}
          start-message: ":robot: Running AI Docs Review..."
          tags: "ai-docs-review"
          reuse-session: true
          dry-run: false
          wait-for-stopped-status: true
          wait-minutes-max: 10
          api-version: "v1"
          advanced-mode: false
```
